title: liquiditybot — problem / solution
description: Every failure mode as a PROBLEM whose panel shows the live detector and names the SOLUTION mechanism already handling it.

panels.title: PROBLEM: stale status
panels.description: Detector: seconds since last status write. SOLUTION: runner wedge-guard escalates a persistently-failing cycle; supervisor revives a dead runner.

panels.title: SOLUTION: Kraken WS
panels.description: Push-book stream. When it drops, the SOLUTION is automatic: the engine falls back to the REST book — trading continues.

panels.title: PROBLEM: stale marks
panels.description: Detector: oldest live mark age. SOLUTION: mark-freshness gate holds non-escape risk actions on stale data; stops still run.

panels.title: SOLUTION: stale assets held
panels.description: Watchdog count of assets quarantined for stale/divergent feeds — entries blocked on them until the feed heals.

panels.title: watchdog: entries blocked
panels.description: Feed watchdog is blocking new entries (a SOLUTION firing).

panels.title: watchdog: critical stale
panels.description: Critical staleness latch.

panels.title: watchdog: divergent feeds
panels.description: Cross-venue book divergence count.

panels.title: watchdog: velocity trip
panels.description: Tick-velocity quarantine (fat-finger guard).

panels.title: PROBLEM: model Brier
panels.description: Detector: rolling outcome Brier. SOLUTION: the ML governor kill-switch (below) disables the model and requests a retrain when Brier drifts past baseline.

panels.title: vs baseline
panels.description: The bar Brier must stay under.

panels.title: SOLUTION: governor
panels.description: 0 OK / 1 shrink+throttle / 2 model killed to the prior.

panels.title: SOLUTION: retrain
panels.description: Auto-retrain queued to replace a degrading champion.

panels.title: calibration gap
panels.description: Miscalibration; ECE.

panels.title: drift share
panels.description: PROBLEM: input drift. SOLUTION: retrain re-fits on fresh data.

panels.title: SOLUTION: kelly throttle
panels.description: Governor shrinks size as confidence falls.

panels.title: model fallbacks
panels.description: Inference fell to the cold-start prior (fail-safe firing).

panels.title: infer faults
panels.description: Inference errors.

panels.title: contract fails
panels.description: Input outside contract.

panels.title: retrain failures
panels.description: Auto-retrain crashed.

panels.title: PROBLEM: drawdown
panels.description: Detector: peak-to-now. SOLUTION: drawdown throttle + the 15% hard-stop flatten.

panels.title: PROBLEM: loss streak
panels.description: Detector: consecutive losers. SOLUTION: the per-asset circuit breaker pauses that asset.

panels.title: SOLUTION: breakers tripped
panels.description: Assets currently paused by the circuit breaker.

panels.title: SOLUTION: heat vs cap
panels.description: Portfolio heat throttled under the CVaR cap.

panels.title: SOLUTION: taper mult
panels.description: Loss-budget taper shrinks size as the daily budget is consumed.

panels.title: daily budget used
panels.description: Daily loss budget consumed.

panels.title: weekly budget used
panels.description: Weekly loss budget consumed.

panels.title: dd throttle mult
panels.description: Drawdown size throttle.

panels.title: SOLUTION: model kelly
panels.description: Kelly size throttle (compounds with taper).

panels.title: Circuit breaker — paused assets
panels.description: Per-asset breaker state; hours-left counts the cool-off.

panels.title: PROBLEM/SOLUTION: op-state
panels.description: Central fault authority: ARMED nominal / DEGRADED no-new-risk / HALTED flatten-and-stop.

panels.title: latched faults
panels.description: Active latched faults.

panels.title: firewall fault
panels.description: Risk-firewall latched fault (blocks new risk).

panels.title: PROBLEM: cycle wedge
panels.description: Detector: consecutive failing cycles. SOLUTION: runner wedge escalation.

panels.title: exit-eval failures
panels.description: A position wedging its own exit path.

panels.title: venue rejects
panels.description: OM-021 AddOrder rejects.

panels.title: dead-man failures
panels.description: OM-050 — resting orders would be unguarded.

panels.title: audit dropped writes
panels.description: Audit-trail write drops.

panels.title: audit tail truncations
panels.description: Audit tail truncations.

panels.title: Firewall — clamps/rejects by code
panels.description: Which firewall rule (FW-*) is clamping/rejecting most.

panels.title: Manipulation suspicion by asset
panels.description: PROBLEM: painted/spoofed books. SOLUTION: THALES shades size and down-weights those training rows.
